standard_prerequisites.name: Soundness of the sequent calculus
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every derivable sequent is valid; the unit proves this as its soundness theorem.
standard_prerequisites.use: It upgrades the derived empty-succedent sequent for Gamma_0 to validity (2303-2305).

standard_prerequisites.name: Inconsistency in the sequent calculus
standard_prerequisites.statement: A set Gamma is inconsistent when some finite subset Gamma_0 has a derivation of the sequent Gamma_0 with empty succedent.
standard_prerequisites.use: It supplies the finite witness set Gamma_0 the proof works with (2301-2303).

standard_prerequisites.name: Validity of an empty-succedent sequent
standard_prerequisites.statement: The sequent Gamma_0 with empty succedent is valid exactly when no structure satisfies all sentences of Gamma_0 simultaneously.
standard_prerequisites.use: It converts the valid sequent into the non-satisfiability of Gamma_0, hence of Gamma (2305-2311).

core_obligations: Contrapositive setup: assume Gamma is not consistent and take the finite Gamma_0 with a derivation of the empty-succedent sequent (2301-2303).
By soundness the sequent is valid, so for every structure some sentence of Gamma_0 is falsified in it (2303-2307).
Since Gamma_0 is part of Gamma, no structure satisfies Gamma, so Gamma is not satisfiable, proving the contrapositive (2307-2311).

proof_roadmap.step: Extract the finite witness of inconsistency.
Apply soundness to make the empty-succedent sequent valid.

difficulty_reason: The counted corollary is the author corollary at source lines 2295-2297: a satisfiable set of sentences is consistent. The author proof (2299-2311) runs the contrapositive through the sequent soundness theorem: an inconsistency supplies a finite subset Gamma_0 with a derivation of the empty succedent, soundness makes that sequent valid, so no structure satisfies all of Gamma_0, and hence none satisfies Gamma. The passage from an infinite inconsistent set to its finite witness and back through validity is the counted move.
